results.title: Letter From Santa Printable, Letter to Santa, Nice List Certificate, Aussie Christmas, Fillable A4 PDF, Santa Envelope
results.description:
Make Christmas morning extra magic with a letter from Santa that uses your child's own name and the kind things they did this year. It comes with a "Dear Santa" letter for your kids to write first. Made for an Aussie summer Christmas: warm nights, cold drinks for the reindeer and hats and sunscreen at the beach. Print it and write it by hand, or type it in the fillable PDF on your phone and then print.

The festive design has rich gold lettering with cursive "I was here!" headlines, holly, baubles, candy-cane borders, gold stars, Christmas trees and stockings, and a wax-sealed Nice List certificate. It's all on a soft cream page, so it feels magical but is still light on ink at home.

WHAT'S INCLUDED (7 pages, A4)
• How to use: step-by-step for parents, phone tips and printing tips
• Letter to Santa: name, age, suburb and state, "this year I have been...", something kind I did, something I'm proud of, a 5-line wishlist, something for someone else, treats to leave out and a question for Santa
• Letter to Santa for little ones: colour the 5 stars, draw or write 3 wishes and a picture for Santa
• Letter from Santa ("I was here!") for Christmas morning, designed like official North Pole mail with parchment, a gold letterhead and a wax seal: your child's name, the treats they left, 3 kind deeds, what Santa's proud of, a P.S. and Santa's delivery note
• Letter from Santa for 2 or 3 kids: one family letter with a name and a kind deed for each child
• Santa's Nice List certificate: name, suburb, year, tick boxes for what they were nice for, and a Head Elf signature line
• Envelope fronts (2 per page): a bright, playful "TO SANTA!" envelope and an official-looking "Special delivery!" from Santa. Each half fits an A5 / C5 envelope

TWO VERSIONS IN ONE DOWNLOAD
• Print PDF: light colours to save ink, so it prints well in colour or black and white. Write it by hand
• Fillable PDF: type into the lines on your phone, tablet or computer, tap to tick, then print. Typing hides your handwriting, so Santa's letter looks like it came from Santa

HOW TO FILL IT IN ON YOUR PHONE
Open the fillable PDF in the free Adobe Acrobat Reader app, the Google Drive app or the iPhone/iPad Files app, then tap a line and type. Apple Books can't fill forms, so use Files. Save a copy for each child so you always keep a blank one.

PRINTING TIPS
• Print at "Actual size / 100%" on A4 paper
• Thicker (120–200 gsm) or cream paper makes Santa's letter feel extra special

THIS IS A DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
You'll get a ZIP file to download from your Etsy Purchases page (Etsy also emails you a link) as soon as payment is confirmed. No physical item will be shipped, and nothing is posted to your child. You fill in and print the letters yourself.

LICENCE
For personal and household use. Print as many copies as your own family needs. Please don't share, resell or redistribute the files.

QUESTIONS OR PROBLEMS?
Message me through Etsy. If a file is faulty or isn't as described, I'll fix it, replace it or refund it. Your rights under the Australian Consumer Law aren't affected.
